Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. We have a standing resale certificate and want to confirm Redwood can accept Grove Supply as tax-exempt for future purchases. Attached is the signed supplier certificate and a copy of our EIN letter.

Quick context: we are a B2B distributor (ShipFrom: 1542 Industrial Way, MN). Our accounting team is trying to clear an invoice hold for PO 88121 while we finish onboarding. Can you confirm what acts as acceptable proof (signed state certificate, blanket multi-state, notarization)? Also let us know if the ship-to match matters for your billing system — we have a primary billing entity (Grove Supply LLC, EIN 12-3456789).

Eli — thanks for sending these over. I looped in Naomi (tax intake) and Vivek (billing) so we can validate and clear the invoice hold if everything checks out. A few clarifying items from our acceptance checklist: see attached redwood-exemption-checklist.pdf.

Can you confirm the following?
- Is the signed certificate covering the billing entity exactly as it appears on invoices ("Grove Supply LLC")?
- Does the certificate cover the ship-from or ship-to addresses, or is it a blanket state certificate? Which states are listed?
- Is the signature on file an authorized signatory (title/printed name) and dated within the last 24 months?

If you prefer, we can accept a notarized copy or a DocuSign envelope with the same fields. Once Naomi confirms, Vivek will remove the hold on PO 88121 and mark future invoices tax-exempt.

Attachment referenced: redwood-exemption-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,

> Is the signed certificate covering the billing entity exactly as it appears on invoices ("Grove Supply LLC")?
Yes — the certificate lists "Grove Supply LLC" and the EIN 12-3456789. I attached a higher-resolution EIN letter (Grove_EIN_Letter.png) in case accounting needs it for cross-check.

> Does the certificate cover the ship-from or ship-to addresses, or is it a blanket state certificate? Which states are listed?
It is a blanket certificate for MN and WI; the certificate explicitly includes a blanket statement that covers multiple ship-to addresses within those states. Ship-from for our sales is the MN address provided.

> Is the signature on file an authorized signatory (title/printed name) and dated within the last 24 months?
Yes — signed by our CFO, Dana R. Whitaker, dated 2026-05-18.

I also attached a scanned copy Grove_Supplier_Cert_signed.pdf (application/pdf) again in case the first transmission truncated. Happy to sign via DocuSign if that expedites acceptance.

Let me know if anything else is required to clear PO 88121. We are trying to get Q3 orders rolling.

Thanks,
Eli
